Lemma
[Cutoff functions with bounded derivatives] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0259 ↗ lem:chow-ii-cutoff-gradient-laplacian-estimates 1. ch14:14.4\group Cutoff Functions

Under the hypotheses of Lemma 2, suppose additionally that \[ tK^2| abla \operatorname {Rc}|^2\le C(\alpha ,r,n)K^4 \] on $B_{g(0)}(p,r/2) imes [0, au ]$. For every integer $m\ge 2$ there is a cutoff $\eta $, supported in $B_{g(0)}(p,r/2^m)$ and equal to one on $B_{g(0)}(p,r/2^{m+1})$, such that \[ | abla \eta |^2\le C(\alpha ,m,n)r^{-2}\eta , \qquad -\Delta \eta \le C(\alpha ,K,r,m,n). \]
Proof

\sketch Apply Lemma 2 with the outer radius $r/2^m$. The assumed bound on $\Theta $, together with $0\le \eta \le 1$, turns its final supremum into a constant depending only on the displayed parameters. Absorbing the powers of $2^m$ into the constant gives both estimates.

□
